# Read in a text file generated by Eprime

Read in a text file generated by Eprime

## Usage

``` r
read_eprime(filename, remove_clock = TRUE)
```

## Arguments

- filename:

  Either the full or relative path to an Eprime .txt file

- remove_clock:

  Whether to exclude the `Clock.Information` XML entries. Enabled by
  default.

## Value

Each line of the file is stored and returned in a character vector.

## Details

The encoding on an Eprime txt file should be UCS-2 Little Endian, but
sometimes this is not the case. We delegate the fussy encoding details
to the
[`stringi::stri_read_lines()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/stringi/man/stri_read_lines.html)
function.

If the file is not an Eprime txt–that is, if it is missing the lines
`*** Header Start ***` and `*** Header End ***`–a warning is raised and
the lines of text are replaced by a dummy header.
